mainEntity.name: What does Smart TV repair cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: This service focuses on app, network, input, slow-interface and repeatable startup complaints. Diagnosis separates television software or hardware work from an external service, account, router or connected-device issue before an estimate is proposed.

mainEntity.name: Do app crashes mean my TV motherboard has failed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. An app failure can involve software, compatibility, account state or the service itself. A boot loop can also have more than one cause. The affected features and model need diagnosis before a motherboard replacement is justified.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide Android TV and Google TV repair support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, model-dependent support is available alongside Samsung Tizen/Smart Hub and LG webOS enquiries. Share the full model and fault first so the platform, supported software and repair feasibility can be checked.

mainEntity.name: Will a factory reset remove my settings or sign me out?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can. The effect depends on the model and reset type; settings, channels or app sign-ins may need restoring. Ask what the proposed reset changes and use the manufacturer’s instructions for the exact set. A reset is not automatically necessary for every complaint.

mainEntity.name: Where can I book Smart TV repair near me in Delhi NCR?

acceptedAnswer.text: GR Solution arranges support across Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida and Ghaziabad, including Dwarka visit enquiries. Share the model, symptom, city and access details. Availability and the service arrangement are confirmed before a visit.

mainEntity.name: How is the Smart TV repair price decided?

acceptedAnswer.text: The confirmed work determines the estimate: software/configuration, input repair and mainboard work are different jobs. Diagnosis is free, and paid work needs your approval. Published market ranges are a reference rather than a fixed quote for your model.

Diagnosis before parts
Smart features first. Hardware only when the evidence supports it.

This service page concentrates on the operating platform, connected devices and startup behaviour. For a physically damaged panel, dark display or display lines, use the relevant screen or LED/OLED repair guide linked below. A television can have more than one fault; diagnosis establishes the scope.
Apps that crash, freeze or stop loading

Record the app name, error message, when the problem began and whether another app opens normally. If the TV menu and an HDMI source still work, that is useful information: the problem may be limited to the app, its service, account state or software compatibility. An older TV can also lose support for a particular app without its display or mainboard having failed.

Before agreeing to paid work, ask what is being restored and how it will be checked. Any app update, reinstallation, reset or firmware work must suit the exact model. Settings and sign-ins can be affected, so the proposed intervention should be explained first. We do not promise to bypass a subscription, restore a discontinued service or make every app compatible with an older platform.
Wi-Fi, streaming and screen-casting problems

For Smart TV repair near me involving a dropped connection, describe whether the TV sees the network, connects but cannot stream, or fails only in one room. Note whether another device works on the same home connection. These observations help distinguish a router, internet-service or configuration problem from a television-side wireless or software issue.

If the model has an Ethernet option or supports casting, tell us which connections have already worked rather than buying an adapter or replacement board in advance. Casting also depends on the source device, compatible apps and network conditions. A TV repair estimate should identify the television work being proposed; it cannot guarantee the performance of an outside internet service.
Android TV, Google TV, Tizen and webOS repair support

For Android TV repair, send the full model number rather than describing every smart television as Android. Sony and other brands use different platforms across model generations; Samsung Tizen/Smart Hub and LG webOS have their own menus, updates and compatibility limits. Manufacturer instructions and available software must match the actual set.

Requests for Android TV repair near me often involve a slow interface, repeated app failures or a TV stuck during startup. A reset is not automatically the correct first step. Note the remaining working features and any recent change, then agree which settings, tuned channels and account access may need restoring if software work is recommended. Never install firmware intended for another model.
HDMI, remote response and repeated startup faults

A single missing HDMI input can involve the source device, cable, input settings, port or processing hardware. Tell us whether another source or port works and whether the TV’s own menu appears. For sound complaints, identify the output in use, such as TV speakers or an attached audio device. A remote response problem should be described separately from the television switching itself off.

A boot loop or frozen logo may relate to software, an external device, power stability or a board fault. Inspection should establish a repeatable test before a motherboard replacement is proposed. If there is no power, liquid damage, smoke or an unusual burning smell, stop using the set and arrange professional inspection; do not open the case to investigate.
